slides.title: An integrated twelve-3U study.
slides.text: Twelve 4 kg 3U envelopes. Two six-level storage banks. One reusable electromagnetic carrier.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Select. Feed. Capture.
slides.text: A guided lead screw transfers one payload sideways into the Z-indexed lift. The lift holds the payload and captive pallet.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Transfer custody positively.
slides.text: Carrier bayonets and lift grip pins overlap custody at handoff. Prove the destination restraint before releasing the other.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Dock. Prove. Clear.
slides.text: The pallet locks to the carrier. The custody frame withdraws clear of the launch path before the shot is enabled.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Only the payload departs.
slides.text: The captive pallet stays on the carrier through arrest and return. The diagram explains the sequence; its timing and motion are conceptual.
slides.label: Conceptual motion / not time-scaled / not a dynamics simulation

slides.title: Evaluate the complete trade.
slides.text: Modeled 1–3 m/s commands. Installed device allocation 156.557 kg. These preplanned mission cases show no advantage over the ideal ground-pretrimmed spring comparator.
slides.label: Computed result / G5-MISSION-01

custody.title: Continuous payload custody.
custody.scope: Feeder, carrier and modeled fault branch / ACR1

slides.title: Retain the inventory.
slides.text: Two fixed six-level banks hold twelve nominal 3U payloads. Select one cell and inhibit host burns during feeding.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Capture the selected payload.
slides.text: The guided pusher feeds the lift. At source level 5 the payload floor is Z830 mm; the lift grips hold its pallet.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Overlap the restraints.
slides.text: At handoff, positive carrier bayonets and outboard lift grip pins establish dual custody. The storage banks and fixed frame are hidden in this view for access.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Prove the clear state.
slides.text: Payload floor Z46 mm. Raised custody frame floor Z190 mm. Prove pallet locks, pusher withdrawal and a clear path before enabling launch.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Retain the pallet during recovery.
slides.text: The payload departs. Carrier and captive pallet arrest together, then return as one retained assembly. This explanatory diagram is not measured motion.
slides.label: Conceptual motion / not time-scaled / not a dynamics simulation

slides.title: Fault → inhibit → retain → verify.
slides.text: Modeled custody/interlock logic; physical fault-response validation is subsequent work. A fault does not authorize an automatic restart.
slides.label: Modeled fault/isolation branch / physical validation subsequent

slides.title: One common starting state.
slides.text: Nominal 500 km SSO. Twelve 4 kg 3U payloads. Generic host: 500 kg wet bus, including 20 kg fuel once; Isp 220 s.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Twelve scheduled releases.
slides.text: Actual computed Gen5 host history, uniform-2 target family. Markers identify the frozen release epochs; the inertial X/Z projection preserves the numerical trajectory.
slides.label: Computed host trajectory / fixed-axis J2 / X–Z projection

slides.title: Host manoeuvre. Point. Release.
slides.text: Host burns provide the departure state and direction. The launcher adds the coupled release contribution. The propagated state depends on both.
slides.label: Conceptual operations diagram / generic host study

slides.title: Frozen full-state targets.
slides.text: Uniform synthetic 2 m/s or alternating 1/3 m/s along-track target families. All payloads and retained host are compared at t = 91800 s: 24 h after the final release.
slides.label: Computed target states / synthetic study cases

slides.title: Coast for loading and safe release.
slides.text: Gen5 reserves 400 s of zero-force loading coast per payload for the declared 355 s cycle. Both architectures keep 5 s pre-release and 20 s post-release zero-force guards.
slides.label: Source-derived operation timing / one 450 s release leg

slides.title: The spring comparator matters.
slides.text: The ideal ground-pretrimmed spring closes both target families at the 1 N and 5 N gates. Preplanned targets give no established Gen5 propellant or initial wet-mass advantage.
slides.label: Computed result / bounded candidate policies

slides.title: Replay checks numerical consistency.
slides.text: Native Orekit 13.1.6 replay and 60→30 s refinement agree within the declared numerical residuals. Numerical agreement is not physical delivery accuracy.
slides.label: Computed numerical agreement / no physical accuracy inference

slides.title: Know the model boundary.
slides.text: Fixed-axis J2 point masses and constant inertial force. Drag, higher gravity, attitude/plume allocation, navigation and finite exit geometry are outside this study.
slides.label: Generic host study / modeled target states

slides.title: A reproducible system result.
slides.text: The tested uniform family closes within the host gates; alternating Gen5 closes at 5 N. Its retained-device penalty is 84.55672 kg. Inspect the frozen inputs and same-input comparison.
slides.label: Computed result / synthetic preplanned target families

slides.title: Start with a controlled configuration.
slides.text: VOLLEY-G5-ACR1: twelve 4 kg 3U payloads, two six-level banks, guided screw transfer, indexed lift and captive carrier pallet.
slides.label: CAD-derived Blender render

slides.title: Resolve the finite geometry.
slides.text: Native geometry defines the magnetic gap, conductor placement and finite stator. CAD/STEP is preserved beside the computational model.
slides.label: Scientific section / controlled geometry

slides.title: Couple the source and moving system.
slides.text: The evaluated 1–3 m/s commands include finite force, electrical behavior, release recoil and carrier arrest within the declared computational assumptions.
slides.label: Computed coupled-shot result

slides.title: Account for the whole shot.
slides.text: The ledger records mechanical energy and copper, inverter, bank and auxiliary terms. Installed device allocation is 149.55672 kg CAD mass plus 7 kg.
slides.label: Computed energy ledger / model result

slides.title: Replay the mission independently.
slides.text: Frozen synthetic target PV states, continuous host arcs, release momentum and independent mass-flow checks support numerical consistency.
slides.label: Computed numerical agreement / Orekit replay

slides.title: Use the result to set the next gate.
slides.text: The evaluated integrated configuration has a traceable computational record. Gen6 mixed-size work and instrumented hardware correlation remain separately identified development.
slides.label: Computed study result / subsequent development identified
